context: Two teens shop for tech and snacks
purpose: Teach: フォント/バッテリー/スタンド/アマゾン/ライオン/タンク/カスタマイズ/タマ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 新しいスマホ、フォントいじってカスタマイズしたい!
lines.en: I want to customize the fonts on my new phone!
lines.style: Bright, immediate energy. Quick attack on the opening. Animated — hands probably moving. No hesitation, full enthusiasm. Natural teen excitement without performing it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいね。バッテリーの持ち、どう?
lines.en: That's cool. How's the battery holding up?
lines.style: Genuine interest, genuinely casual. Not trying to fill the moment — just asking what he actually wants to know. Steady, unperformed tone. Light.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: まあまあ。帰りにスタンドでガソリン入れてから、アマゾンで頼んでた荷物、ピックアップ。
lines.en: It's okay. I'm stopping for gas on the way home, then picking up an Amazon package.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, practical tone. Running through the plan like she's already thought it through. No drama. Quick pace, slightly clipped — she's listing things, not narrating.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ライオン柄のケース、まだ売ってるかな。
lines.en: I wonder if that lion-pattern case is still available.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly tentative. Genuine question to himself more than to her. Softer attack. A little uncertain — he cares about this choice. Not cool-distant; genuinely wondering.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: タマ(玉)模様も最近流行ってるよ。
lines.en: Oh, polka-dot designs are trending right now too.
lines.style: Helpful side note, not showing off. She's offering information because he's thinking about it. Warm, casual. Almost conversational — like she's just remembering something he might want to know.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 帰り、車のタンクも要チェックな。
lines.en: By the way, make sure to check the car's fuel tank on your way back.
lines.style: Practical reminder, almost protective without being preachy. Low-key responsible — he's just making sure she doesn't forget. Brief, sincere. No edge.
